title: A three-day-old article shows up now, and an article has no date at all
notes: old-article is dated 3 days before W1 but first listed in W1 (C3): it must not hold the window and, if used, needs time framing. undated has no pubDate (C4): treat as current, not old. fresh-anchor is a normal current item so W1 has something ordinary to publish.

items.title: Ardena mayor announces plan for river park
items.body: Ardena's mayor, Sofi Lind, on Saturday announced a plan to turn four kilometres of disused riverbank into a public park by 2029. The first section, near the old tannery, would open in 2027. The plan still needs approval from the regional council.

items.title: Ardena water supply restored after main burst
items.body: Water supply has been restored to about 12,000 homes in eastern Ardena after a main burst under Station Road, the city water company said. Residents were told to run taps for two minutes before drinking the water.

items.title: Ardena airport adds winter flights to two capitals
items.body: Ardena airport will add weekly flights to two foreign capitals from December, the airport operator said on Tuesday. The routes will run until the end of March.
